limits: Holding out keys still leaves the same combination observed in other cells.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI.

the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.observed: identity and pathway arms give numerically identical predictions: global rho 0.3774 for both, gain +0.0000 [-0.0000,+0.0000]
the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.why: checked directly: each drug maps to exactly one pathway level (46 anchor drugs, 65 library drugs, zero drugs with more than one level). So the pathway one-hots are a deterministic function of the drug one-hots, the added block spans no new directions, and a ridge fit cannot use it.
the_zero_is_algebraic_not_dead.conclusion: this is not a dead arm; it is an algebraic fact about the features

what_this_reframes.the_old_reading: the pathway annotation carries information beyond drug identity
what_this_reframes.the_correct_reading: the pathway annotation is a COARSENING of drug identity. It adds nothing when identity is available and is the only channel when identity is not.

this_explains_everything_seen_so_far.the_six_times_decay: the gain tracks how much of the identity block is unavailable, which is why both-unseen pools gain 0.13 and seen pools gain nothing or almost nothing
this_explains_everything_seen_so_far.the_permutation_failure: permuting the drug-to-pathway map destroys the coarsening so the substitute stops being a valid stand-in
this_explains_everything_seen_so_far.the_pathway_versus_tissue_muddle: both blocks are coarsenings of identity, one of the drug and one of the cell, which is why neither behaved like independent evidence

what_this_reframes.what_this_costs: the result is no longer a knowledge-augmentation finding. It is a cold-start fallback finding: a coarser description of a drug still ranks pairs usefully when the drug itself is unseen. That is a smaller claim than it looked.

the_decay_curve_is_now_complete.reading: the gain is monotone in how much of the identity block is missing, with a hard zero at the full-information end
